description: This file declares interfaces, data types, and function prototypes for the IARM-Bus API used in inter-process communication within RDK-based systems. It includes definitions for event handling, RPC registration and invocation, connection management, and other bus operations.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Init
methods.description: Initializes the IARM bus with a specified client name, preparing it for operations.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Term
methods.description: Terminates the IARM bus, releasing resources and reverting to uninitialized state.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Connect
methods.description: Connects the application to the IARM daemon, enabling communication.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Disconnect
methods.description: Disconnects the application from the IARM bus.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_BroadcastEvent
methods.description: Publishes an asynchronous event to all registered clients.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_RegisterCall
methods.description: Registers an RPC method with a specific name and handler.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Call
methods.description: Invokes a registered RPC method on another application.

methods.name: IARM_Bus_Call_with_IPCTimeout
methods.description: Invokes a registered RPC method with a specified timeout.
